It has a rounded, shield-like body shape with visible stitching along the edges. There is a small embroidered detail or patch on the lower right side and a triangular fabric reinforcement or decorative element near the neck curve.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and not another garment accessory.
To verify the edges are sharp and the object is a single continuous piece of fabric without melting into the background.
To check for subtle texture anomalies in the fabric weave or stripe alignment that might indicate AI generation.
To ensure the bib lies flat on the surface with consistent contact shadows and no floating artifacts.

focus_areas: Edge sharpness of the fabric against the background
Consistency of the stripe pattern across folds and curves
Structural integrity of the snap fastener
Naturalness of fabric wrinkles and lighting
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the stripe pattern continuity. In AI images, patterns often distort unnaturally around curves or seams. Verify if the stripes align logically with the fabric's geometry. Also, inspect the snap fastener for realistic metallic/plastic reflection and attachment to the fabric.
